POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL superuser username. Referenced by pelican as ${{pelican-db.POSTGRES_USER}}.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL superuser password. Auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced by pelican as ${{pelican-db.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database name. Pelican uses this database for all its data.

POSTGRES_PORT.description: Port PostgreSQL listens on inside the container. Must stay 5432.

PGDATA.description: Data directory inside the volume. Points below the mount root to avoid the lost+found conflict.
